title: RAGOps
body: Built a query router using an all-MiniLM-L6-v2 classifier to select retrieval strategy. Combined Qdrant vector search and BM25 keyword search using RRF fusion and cross-encoder reranking. Developed a 7-node LangGraph pipeline supporting standard and multi-hop queries, achieving Hit@5 of 0.75, with Redis caching for up to 30x faster repeated queries.

title: JobCrew
body: Built a multi-agent job application assistant for federal jobs using 5 CrewAI agents to analyze listings, tailor resumes, prepare interviews, and identify skill gaps. Integrated USAJobs API to fetch live job listings, supporting resume upload, application tracking, and one-click materials generation.

title: MailPilot MCP
body: Built an AI Gmail assistant using MCP client-server architecture for natural language email search and summarization. Implemented Google OAuth authentication, secure token handling, and a ReAct reasoning loop with human approval before creating Gmail drafts, along with multi-turn conversational memory.

title: Fake Currency Detection
body: Built a deep learning model to classify real and fake Indian currency notes using MobileNetV2 transfer learning and CBAM attention. Achieved precision, recall, and ROC-AUC of 0.9986, combining currency images with precomputed feature embeddings, preprocessed using OpenCV.

title: Micro-Transformer from Scratch
body: A minimal, character-level Generative Transformer model built step-by-step in PyTorch. Implemented tokenization, encoding/decoding, train/val split, and random batch generation with autoregressive target shift verification, building towards queries, keys, values, self-attention, and full Transformer blocks.

title: TalentRank AI
body: A production-grade AI ranking pipeline identifying the Top 100 candidates from 100,000 synthetic profiles for a Senior AI Engineer role at Redrob AI, featuring honeypot fake detection (catching 58% of synthetic fakes), hybrid BM25 + semantic retrieval with RRF fusion, and LightGBM re-ranking.

title: ParcelPilot
body: An intelligent, multi-tenant AI support assistant designed to automate parcel policy searches, order tracking, and ticket investigations with secure tenant-isolated data access. Implemented precedence-aware RAG, outdated policy protection, and human-in-the-loop approval actions.
